alt: Real ChatGPT /quiz execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /quiz Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive three-question quiz about tokens, context and parameters. Show feedback and let me advance one question at a time. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Open a hint before answering the tokenizer question.
Choose the embedding-vector option to inspect incorrect-answer feedback.
Read the explanation, then advance to the context question.
Open a hint for the context intervention.
Choose the available-context answer and read the correct feedback.
Advance to the final question about parameters.
Read a hint for the relationship between retrieval and model parameters.
Choose the explanation distinguishing external context from parameter updates.
Finish the quiz and inspect the result of all three answers.
Review the 2/3 summary and the explanation of the earlier mistake.
Restart the same quiz to practise the difficult concept again.
Correct the earlier mistake by selecting numerical token identifiers.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
